purpose: Falsify three new OHLC-only cross-sectional mechanisms distinct from Discovery v2 Sprints 1-5.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after signal

wick_rejection_followthrough.hypothesis: Persistent lower-wick rejection versus upper-wick rejection on completed daily candles contains directional follow-through information into the next daily period.
wick_rejection_followthrough.score: mean daily_score over the most recent N completed bars ending at t
wick_rejection_followthrough.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

return_efficiency_continuation.hypothesis: Assets whose multi-day net move is large relative to total path length are in cleaner directional trends and exhibit next-day continuation.
return_efficiency_continuation.score: sum of completed close-to-close returns over N bars divided by sum of absolute completed close-to-close returns over the same N bars
return_efficiency_continuation.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

realized_semivariance_balance.hypothesis: Persistent asymmetry between positive and negative realized squared returns captures directional pressure beyond total volatility and predicts next-day relative continuation.
realized_semivariance_balance.score: (sum positive_return_squared - sum negative_return_squared) / sum all_return_squared over the most recent N completed returns
realized_semivariance_balance.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent reproduction, different-source D2, non-overlapping temporal D3 and prospective D4
